title: JEE Main 2026 (April 2nd, Shift 2) - Mathematics - Sequences and Series
subject: Mathematics

questions.q: Let $a_1, a_2, a_3, \dots$ be an A.P. and $g_1 = a_1, g_2, g_3, \dots$ be an increasing G.P. If $a_1 = a_2 + g_2 = 1$ and $a_3 + g_3 = 4$, then $a_{10} + g_5$ is equal to:
questions.explain:
From the given, $a_1 = 1$. Let $d$ be common difference of AP and $r$ be common ratio of GP. Then $a_2 = 1 + d$ and $g_2 = r$.
We have $a_2 + g_2 = 1 \implies 1 + d + r = 1 \implies d = -r$.
Also, $a_3 + g_3 = 4 \implies (1 + 2d) + r^2 = 4 \implies 1 - 2r + r^2 = 4 \implies (r-1)^2 = 4$.
Since the GP is increasing ($r > 1$), $r-1 = 2 \implies r = 3$. Then $d = -3$.
$a_{10} = 1 + 9(-3) = -26$. $g_5 = 1 \cdot 3^4 = 81$.
$a_{10} + g_5 = -26 + 81 = 55$.
